sentences.en: I went camping in the Japan Alps with my club.
sentences.zh: 我与俱乐部成员一起去日本 Alps 露营了。

sentences.en: Each of his friends is going to camp this summer.
sentences.zh: 他的每个朋友这个夏天都要去露营。

sentences.en: They visited us at the camp during summer vacation.
sentences.zh: 他们在暑假期间来营地拜访我们。

senses.zh: 做作的；夸张的；娘娘腔的
